items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Buddy DeFranco as local talent; Interviewee responds generally about hearing radio shows and knowing musicians like Woody Herman's band members but 'didn't know them personally' in that context, and does not mention DeFranco specifically in his response.

ctx.x: I lived in what they called Logan. It’s 4800 North. When I was about ten I started traveling the city myself on the subway and so forth. Because being an only child and my mother working all day I had to get around by myself. So that was good.
Did you... now early on, were you aware of some of the local talent [clears throat] that was in Philly. I know there’s certain musicians a little bit older than you like
Joe Wilder or Buddy DeFranco, but since Philly has produced a wealth of fantastic musicians...
